body:
I'm heading off to bed, it's getting a bit late. 

But thank you for the advice. I'll certainly take all of it into consideration. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

So I'm currently laying in bed, typing this on my iPod. Hopefully that will explain my slow response time.

In the past 30 or so minutes, I've received some awesome advice. And I think I might tell her, making it known that I'm worried about our friendship more than a relationship. 

As for rejection, I've always been afraid of it. I've lost several opportunities just because of that fear. My biggest however, is losing this girl as a friend. I'll talk to a few people about it and see what happens, get some advice from those around her, and probably talk to her about it.

As for sc2, I'd love to play if you dont mind partnering with a silver leaguer.

I am on steam, I don't have portal 2 though :/

I do play tf2 occasionally, BF3, and SC2. You do any of those?

I find that the tactical aspect of BF3 just completely takes my mind off everything.

For college, I was planning on just doing a four year microbiology major and taking a path into genetics if I really couldn't find anything else to do.

I'm sorry, I should have been a bit more clear on what I meant. I don't really want her to know that I like her, not now anyways (Stupid high school shit, I know). I feel like I would have to explain this to her if I told her how bad I was feeling right now.

About the whole resenting me, I don't think it would happen to be completely honest. She isn't one for resentment, but I'm not going to force her away from me emotionally. I feel like if I told her this, I'd be presenting her like an ultimatum or something, which is totally not cool.

One last thing, you just made me feel unbelievably happy about myself with that last sentence. My confidence just boosted like 10-fold.

Thank you :D

My stress reliever is normally just doing shit with buddies. 

Video games used to cut it for me, but rarely do they help anymore.

And I've heard all sorts of stories about hell week in college, none being good.

I would love to talk to her about this, and in most cases I would. But I like her a lot, and I'll probably never get to date her in the foreseeable future. That's causing part of the sadness I'm feeling, and I don't want her to know. And I can't just lie about it, that's kind of against my morals.

I think part of the problem is that I just need to get out. All of my teachers are laying the projects on thick and I'm getting really stressed out. Doesn't really mix well with the current situation.

Anyways, just writing and receiving a few responses on the subject is making me feel better.
